name: GPS Tracker
description: A high precision GPS tracker for vehicles and personal use.

name: Alarm Unit
description: A special alarm installed within the vehicle to prevent theft.

name: Steering wheel locks
description: Bright metal bars (like The Club) or full cover locks that physically block the wheel from turning.

name: Pedal and gear locks
description: Devices that lock your brake, clutch, or gear shift in place so the car cannot be driven.

name: Faraday pouches / boxes
description: Small, signal-blocking sleeves that hold keyless entry fobs to stop thieves from copying your key's wireless signal.
